new_mathematical_result: In the actual sliced polynomial four-ring, a successful primitive mixed-cubic lift remains successful and primitive along any finite elementary coordinate word whose every intermediate frame has three E-degree-one goods, one E-degree-two bad, rank-two speeds and dense speed cone. The invariant changes only by nonzero constant scaling and an additive constant; its subring C[I] is preserved.
proof_chain: Retained130 recognition and the elementary cubic plane-coordinate criterion normalize a successful lift to I=XW-F(Y)-delta*Z, with cubic F and nonzero cubic and Z coefficients. The required bad shear has ordinary degree at most two and cannot remove the acceleration because primitivity puts q outside W2.

Dense cone makes the three good initials and the two projective speed ratios faithful. At fixed E-degree every normal-monomial leading comparison has a common nonzero factor (EX)^d; no unit assumption is used.

For an arbitrary held-coordinate ring after normalization, rational dependence of its three initials forces its good forms to span X,Y and its quadratic bad shear to be independent of Z. This follows by two reductions modulo the pole variable X.

The remaining actual ring is C[X,Y,W+beta*Z]. Normal monomials in X,Y,Hbeta=X(W+beta*Z)-F(Y),W+beta*Z have disjoint leading exponents, giving exactly the E-affine subspaces stated in equation6 for beta zero and nonzero.

Only the beta-zero case permits a nonlinear good update. Its new speed coefficient theta is nonzero by density and its corrected invariant is kappa/theta times I. Other good updates and all allowed bad updates are the retained affine/quadratic covariance. Induct along the finite word.
scope_counterexample: Seven explicitly invertible elementary shears conjugate the adapted invariant shear a -> a+b into the cubic129 frame. Both endpoints pass the gates, but C[a] changes to C[a+b]. The total automorphism commutes with E; the factorization loses dense cone at step1 and quadratic bad degree at step3. This disproves unrestricted subring preservation, not primitive gate passage or cancellation.
